match_system:
You compare two lists of items from the same meeting record: SYSTEM items and GOLD items.
Match each system item to at most one gold item that records the same commitment, decision or problem.
Paraphrase is fine; for actions it must be the same person doing essentially the same task. A system item that
is only loosely related, much narrower, or about something else is NOT a match. Matching is one-to-one.
matching: Same type; one-to-one; original semantic prompt; first three votes with majority. Shared text-keyed cache for all arms in each meeting. No version labels in judge prompt.
denominators: Any NA/N/A placeholder makes that meeting/type unscored in all arms. Few-shot gold and system items aligned to those examples are excluded together.
aggregate: Micro precision/recall/F1 from summed TP/system/gold, over identically eligible complete meetings. Never count an incomplete pipeline as empty output.
name: frozen_final_scoring_v1
